'''Tobiaz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the uncle of [[Jilka Zan Zentis]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] Treasury agent. Tobiaz usually visits Zentis and her family for dinner during [[Republic Day/Legends|Republic Day]] celebrations. Zentis and her family were not entirely sure whether or not he was a serial killer.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
